Written in C++ (fork of PISA with a vectorized query processor).
Index is read from disk via mmap.
Doc deltas and frequencies are encoded using SIMD-BP128 with blocks of size 128.
Disjunctive top-k queries use a vectorized block-max MaxScore algorithm that partitions the document space into windows and scores candidates from the essential lists in batches.
Conjunctive and single-term top-k queries use ranked AND.
Doc IDs are reordered using recursive graph bisection.
